Discurso do Senhor Governador na Cerimnia de Abertura da Conferncia Superviso Bancria, Experincia e Desafios, Equivalncia de Superviso Bancaria dos Bancos Centrais. Excelentssimos Senhores Membros do Conselho de Administrao do Banco Nacional de Angola Ilustres Convidados, Minhas Senhoras Meus Senhores; Em nome do Conselho de Administrao do Banco Nacional de Angola, gostaria de dar as boas vindas a todos os nossos convidados, representantes das instituies financeiras, entidades pblicas e privadas, bem como de organismos internacionais presentes nesta magna Conferncia, que se prope ser um marco indelvel na abordagem dos novos desafios da regulao para o reforo da superviso bancria que se pretende efectivar no nosso pas. Ao abrigo da Constituio da Republica de Angola, da Lei do Banco Nacional de Angola e da Lei de Base das Instituies Financeiras, o Banco Nacional de Angola, enquanto entidade reguladora e supervisora do sistema Financeiro Angolano, tem assumido as suas funes de agente dinamizador da mudana no sistema financeiro nacional e da implementao das melhores praticas internacionais, cujo objetivo primordial consiste em adequar o quadro regulamentar vigente aos princpios de Basileia, almejando-se com isto uma superviso equivalente, isto , a proximidade objectivo, eficcia, metodologia e resultados alcanados entre dois ou mais organismos de superviso em jurisdies diferentes. DISTINTOS CONVIDADOS, MINHAS SENHORAS E MEUS SENHORES, Quando o actual Conselho de Administrao assumiu funes, em 2016, e face s actuais dificuldades do sistema financeiro Angolano, originada pelo choque com a queda dos preos internacionais do principal produto de exportao, o Petrleo, igualmente principal fonte de receitas do estado Angolano, foi dedicada uma ateno especial ao enorme desafio de reviso e modernizao da regulamentao e superviso das instituies bancrias e no bancrias. Deste modo, uma das primeiras medidas tomadas por expressa orientao do Titular do Executivo, foi lanar o projecto de adequao do sistema Financeiro Angolano s Normas prudnciais e boas prticas Internacionais. Tratou-se de um marco fulcral na abordagem dos novos paradigmas da regulao e superviso bancria em prol da estabilidade do sistema Financeiro Angolano. A implementao deste plano levou-nos, no mbito da uniformizao das prticas de superviso bancria, a trabalhar em colaborao com entidades congneres internacionais em vrios pases designadamente, Afrca do Sul, Portugal, Itlia, Frana, Reino Unido e Estados Unidos da Amrica. Entretanto, impem-se-nos, antes de nos debruarmos sobre algumas questes mais direcionadas ao tema da presente conferncia, dar uma breve nota sobre a actual evoluo do sistema financeiro bancrio. Ora, o sistema bancrio Angolano conta actualmente com 30 instituies financeiras bancrias autorizadas, das quais 29 em actividade. A taxa de bancarizao em Dezembro de 2016 situava-se nos 52,92%, e o sistema bancrio conta com um total de 6.719.407 clientes. Em Dezembro de 2016 o mesmo sistema bancrio apresentava um volume de negcios superior a 10 mil milhes de USD, o crdito total  economia correspondia a 3 mil milhes de USD, o crdito vencido sobre o crdito total representa cerca de 25.37%. Em termos de adequao de capital, o sistema financeiro apresentava um rcio de solvabilidade regulamentar em cerca de 19.74%. Minhas Senhoras e meus Senhores, Nos ltimos anos registaram-se transformaes significativas na economia angolana, em particular no sector bancrio. Nesta particular, importa considerar que aps uma avaliao sobre o real estado do sistema financeiro Angolano, atravs do programa de avaliao do sector financeiro (FSAP), realizado em 2010, o Banco Nacional de Angola tomou iniciativas como a confirmao do quadro legal e regulamentar, em sede de polticas de Branqueamento de Capitais e Financiamento ao Terrorismo, adequado de capital, governao corporativa e sistema de controlo interno, bem como a adopo plena de normas internacionais de contabilidade e de relato financeiro (IAS/IFRS), assim como de defesa do consumidor de produtos e servios financeiros. Excelencias,. Minhas Senhoras e meus Senhores, Um dos objectivos principais do BNA, enquanto autoridade monetria e cambial,  o de garantir a estabilidade de preos, o controlo da meta da inflao e a confiana do sistema financeiro e bancrio. Deste modo, visando adequar o sistema bancrio angolano s normas prudnciais e boas Prticas Internacionais, foram provados e publicados em 2016, 48 normativos, que regulam a matria sobre Fundos Prprios Regulamentares, adopo plena das normas internacionais de Contabilidade e Relato Financeiro, Governao do Risco, Conceptualizao do Crdito, Teste de Esforo e Normas de Conduta. No tocante s normas de conduta, quero aqui destacar, o novo pacote de medidas sobre a superviso Comportamental, que visa reforar a solidez e os mecanismos de proteco dos interesses dos consumidores de produtos e servios financeiros, visados mitigar o risco de conduta das instituies financeiras no mbito do exerccio da sua actividade. Minhas Senhoras e Meus Senhores, As aces atrs listadas, muito tm contribuido para o desenvolvimento do processo de superviso das instituies financeiras, alinhando-o s melhores prticas internacionais, apoiado no Manual de Superviso, no qual so formalizados e sistematizados os procedimentos para uma superviso bancria baseada no risco. Para a sua efectivao, foi desenvolvido e implementado um Modelo de Avaliao de Risco das Instituies Financeiras, considerando as categorias de Risco de Crdito de Mercado, Operacional e de Liquidez. O modelo  composto ainda pelas seguintes componentes: Controlo Interno Governao Corporativa Preveno e Combate ao Branqueamento de Capitais e Financiamento ao Terrorismo Solvabilidade e Liquidez, o que tem permitido fortalecer o processo de interveno de superviso, contribuindo para a melhoria da qualidade da informao. Distintos Participantes Reconhecemos que h ainda um caminho longo a percorrer, porm, estamos convictos de que as aces realizadas at ao momento permite-nos assegurar que os desafios da regulao e superviso que ainda persistem, continuam no centro das nossas preocupaes rumo a sua superao. Assim sendo, o Banco Nacional de Angola, em colaborao com os demais rgos do Estado Angolano, continuar a trabalhar no aprimoramento das aces visando a adequao do sistema Financeiro Angolano s normas Prudnciais e boas prticas Internacionais, designadamente, os trs grandes pacotes regulatrios que ficaram conhecidos como BASILEIA I,II e III, e dando relevncia: A REGULAO E SUPERVISO BANCRIA, AO NVEL DO CONTROLO E GESTO DO RISCO AOS PRINCPIOS FUNDAMENTAIS PARA UMA SUPERVISO BANCRIA EFECTIVA AO REFORO E ACOMPANHAMENTO DA IMPLEMENTAO DA ACES DE PREVENO DO BRANQUEAMENTO DECAPITAIS E COMBATE AO FINANCIAMENTO AO TERRORISMO Para o efeito esto igualmente previstas aces de formao e sensibilizao das instituies financeiras, sob a sua superviso. Por ultimo, para o alcance de uma superviso interna ao nvel da aproximao da regulao e maturao dos processos de superviso do BNA, est a ser levado a cabo um programa de formao e capacitao contnuo das equipes de regulao e superviso, administrados pela sua Academia do BNA, e aces de formaes especializadas no Exterior do Pas, no mbito dos acordos de cooperao rubricados com organismos de superviso congneres, visando a partilha de experincias e conhecimento em matrias afins. Excelncias, Minhas Senhora e meus Senhores, Convictos de que este magno evento ao congregar especialistas de diferentes partes do mundo, nas matrias j refernciadas e que constituem temas de actualidade resumem-se indubitavelmente na oportunidade de juntos refletirmos sobre que melhores prticas podero ser adoptadas para que os desafios que se impem ao sistema financeiro angolano possam ser ultrapassados. Deste modo, declaro, com elevada satisfao, aberta esta Conferncia, reiterando os agradecimentos aos oradores que aceitaram participar do evento, com votos de que se sintam bem em Angola, pas que vos recebe com muito agrado. Muito obrigado pela vossa ateno. Title: Opening Speech at the commemoration of the 42nd Anniversary of the Taking of Banking
text: Opening Speech of the Deputy Governor of BNA, Suzana Camacho Monteiro in the celebration of the 42nd Anniversary of the Banking Opening Speech of the Deputy Governor of the BNA, Suzana Camacho Monteiro at the celebration of the 42nd Anniversary of the Banking Your Honors, gentlemen, Distinguished Guests, Ladies and gentlemen; On behalf of the Board of Directors of the National Bank of Angola, I would like to thank you for the addressed to us by the National Union of Employees of Angola (SNEBA) and to welcome all representatives of the Financial Institutions, Public and Private Entities present, solemn act that marks the "42nd Anniversary of the Taking of Banking", subject to the theme: "The Angolan - Ethics, professional deontology, its social role, perspectives versus the international context" which is proposed to be an indelible milestone in the framework of Historical Evolution of the Angolan Financial System." This commemoration obliges us to take a brief journey into the past to better situate the current context of our banking system. Fact that leads us, also, to recall that the history of Angolan banking began with the "Tomada da Banca", on 14 August 1975, motivated by the political situation lived at the time, at the time of the Transitional Government. We highlight here, the important intervention in banking by the Secretary of State for Finance, whose portfolio belonged to the MPLA, dr. Saidy Mingas being the Secretary of State at the time. For by this time, the story that was taking place abnormal movements of capital outflow from Angola to Portugal, at least that a prompt intervention was justified to put an end to this situation. This was in fact a intervention of a nature and greater political than technical to the extent that we were still three months away from proclaiming our country's independence. However, only from 1980 on, we began to celebrate indeed that date, thereby honouring the memory of the paintings that made no effort to fight by taking the Banking, an indispensable step for The Banking Angolan. Distinguished guests, Ladies and gentlemen, In 1975, the banking financial system consisted of a small number of banks, On the one hand, with banco de Angola, to perform the function of issuing and commercial bank; And, on the other hand, with other commercial banks operating in national territory, namely the Bank Angola (BCA), the Commercial Credit Bank and the (BCCI), Banco Totta Standard de Angola (BTSA), Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) and Bank Inter United (BIU). They also operated four institutions credit, specifically, or Instituto de Credito de Angola (ICRA), Banco de Fomento Nacional (BFN), Caixa de Credito Agro-Pecuario (CCAP) and Montepio de Angola. It should also be noted that, from 1976 to the present date, with the passage of the centralized economy for the market economy, the banking system angolan has been experiencing several and profound transformations as a result of an environment of stability in political, economic and social terms, therefore, the emergence of new banking financial institutions and not banking companies, accompanied by new financial products and services associated with new information technologies. Thus, the National Financial System now has 30 (thirty) authorized banks and 29 (twenty- nine) in effective operation and several financial institutions non-banking. Angolan banks' efforts to increase their internationalization have been notorious through subsidiaries, branches, representative offices and/or acquisition of social holdings, in particular in neighbouring financial markets and other countries portuguese-speaking language, notably in Namibia, Africa Portugal, Cape Verde, Sao Tome and Principe and Brazil. Moreover, the changes that have been underway in the regulatory framework applicable to the banking sector, with adjustment of legislation to the macroeconomic and financial dynamics of our country, namely the Law of the National Angola, the Basic Law of Financial Institutions, the on The Prevention of Money Laundering and Combating Terrorist Financing, and arguably the set of Warnings, Instructional and Directives prudential, behavioural, organisational, accounting, Corporate Governance and internal controls, among others, aligned with the internationally accepted banking practices. Dignissimos, It is our conviction, that all these transformations were only possible because they always had, in the center, human capital, understood here, of the Central Bank and bankers and bank workers, who are always required, expected, to ethically wholesome, deontologically professional posture for the continuous building, solidification and improvement of the Angolan Financial System, thus taking into account, on the one hand, to the designs and expectations of economic operators, families and investors and, on the other hand, their employers' institutions, while safeguarding interests of depositors, taking into account the role that depositors banks should play for the well-being of society and consequently for the development of sustainable development of the country's economy. It is quite true that some challenges persist. However, it is important here to mention that the performance of banks, the levels and the state of credit to the economy have been duly monitored by the National Bank of Angola, with the implementation of measures and mechanisms that you have all been following, ensuring compliance not only with international good practice, but also on the stability of financial and the general level of prices. Despite the constraints our economy has been going through since mid-2014, stemming from the slowdown in price of the Barrel of oil, which limited the availability of foreign exchange, the inflation has been slowing, after increasing by an average of about 3% in 2016, and less than 2% by July 2017, from 41.9% in December 2017 to 31.89% in July 2017, as a result of the BNA's restrictive monetary policy. Complaints from depositors, consumers of financial products and services also have particular attention from the National Bank of Angola. However, we reiterate the joint work of the Banking industry with the Central Bank. Bank workers: They should be guided by high standards of professional ethics and avoid situations that could conflicts of interest, and they are responsible, in particular, for the participate in any economic or financial operation that could harm its independence or impartiality. They should be aware of the importance of their duties and responsibilities to their employer's institution, taking into account the expectations of citizens and institutions in relation to their conduct, within socially accepted standards, and behave in such a way as to strengthen the confidence of the Financial System Angolan. They should also be aware that, as a rule, any and all information obtained or result from the performance of their tasks, are considered "Confidential" and it is expressly prohibited to disclose or make known the persons of others, under penalty of being disciplinary and criminally Held responsible. In this way, we believe that there needs to be more investment in human capital, not only in specialized training, but above all of ethics and professional deontology, aimed at bank workers, which are appealed to comply with the scrupulously the Codes of Conduct of its institutions. "Ethics and professional deontology are a fundamental tool for healthy and sustainable management, prudent of the banks." Hence the theme was chosen for the meeting of today. Gentlemen and ladies, Distinguished guests; We recognise that there is still a way to go, but we must recognise the gains achieved to achieve the stability of the financial system. Let's go continue to work together towards the adequacy of our Banking System to best practices International. I conclude by thanking the attention given and reaffirming our confidence that, united in the common effort to build a dynamic banking system, we will certainly make a valuable contribution to our country successfully addressing the challenges ensuring macroeconomic stability and financial crisis, in view of the adversities of the external scenario of lower oil barrel prices, for the consolidation of the diversification of the economy, through the credit. THANK YOU VERY MUCH! Aug. 16. 2017

A presente comemorao obriga-nos a fazer uma breve viagem ao passado para melhor situar o actual contexto do nosso sistema bancrio. Facto que nos leva, igualmente, a rememorar que a histria da banca angolana comeou com a Tomada da Banca, a 14 de Agosto de 1975, motivada pela conjuntura poltica que se vivia na altura, aquando do Governo de Transio. Realamos aqui, a insigne interveno na banca, por parte da Secretaria de Estado das Finanas, cuja pasta pertencia ao MPLA, sendo o Dr. Saidy Mingas, o Secretrio de Estado na altura. Pois, por esta altura, reza a historia que estavam a ocorrer movimentos anormais de sada de capitais de Angola para Portugal, pelo que se justificava uma pronta interveno para pr cobro  esta situao. Tratou-se de facto de uma interveno de natureza e maior pendor poltico do que tcnico, na medida em que, estvamos ainda  trs meses da proclamao da independncia do nosso Pas. Entretanto, somente a partir de 1980, comeou-se a comemorar efectivamente essa data, honrando assim a memria dos quadros que no mediram esforos para lutar pela tomada da Banca, passo imprescindvel para a Banca Angolana. Distintos convidados, Minhas senhoras e meus senhores, Em 1975, o sistema financeiro bancrio era composto por um reduzido nmero de bancos, Por um lado, com o Banco de Angola, a desempenhar a funo de banco emissor e comercial; E, por outro, com outros bancos comerciais, a operarem em territrio nacional nomeadamente o Banco Comercial de Angola (BCA), o Banco de Crdito Comercial e Industrial (BCCI), o Banco Totta Standard de Angola (BTSA), o Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) e o Banco Inter Unido (BIU). Tambm operavam quatro instituies de crdito, concretamente, o Instituto de Crdito de Angola (ICRA), Banco de Fomento Nacional (BFN), Caixa de Crdito Agro-Pecurio (CCAP) e o Montepio de Angola. Importa ainda referir, que, a partir de 1976 at  presente data, com a passagem do sistema de economia centralizada para economia de mercado, o sistema bancrio angolano tem vindo a registar diversas e profundas transformaes, como resultado de um ambiente de estabilidade em termos polticos, econmicos e sociais, observando-se por conseguinte, o surgimento de novas instituies financeiras bancrias e no bancrias, acompanhadas de novos produtos e servios financeiros associados s novas tecnologias de informao. Assim, o Sistema Financeiro Nacional conta hoje com 30 (trinta) Bancos autorizados e 29 (vinte e nove) em efectivo funcionamento e vrias instituies financeiras no bancrias. Tm sido notrios, os esforos dos bancos angolanos em aumentar a sua internacionalizao, atravs de filiais, sucursais, escritrios de representao e/ ou aquisio de participaes socias, em especial nos mercados financeiros vizinhos e noutros pases de lngua oficial portuguesa, nomeadamente na Nambia, na frica do Sul, em Portugal, em Cabo Verde, em So Tom e Prncipe e no Brasil. Outrossim, destacam-se as transformaes que se tm vindo a registar no quadro regulamentar aplicvel ao sector bancrio, com ajustamento da legislao  dinmica Macroeconmica e Financeira do nosso Pas, designadamente, a Lei do Banco Nacional de Angola, a Lei de Base das Instituies Financeiras, a Lei referente  Preveno de Branqueamento de Capitais e Combate ao Financiamento ao Terrorismo, e indiscutivelmente o conjunto de Avisos, Instrutivos e Directivas sobre matrias de natureza prudencial, comportamental, organizacional, contabilstica, de Governao Corporativa e controlos internos, dentre outras, alinhadas s boas prticas bancrias internacionalmente aceites. Dignssimos,  nossa convico, que todas essas transformaes, somente foram possveis porque tiveram sempre, no centro, o capital humano, entenda-se aqui, do Banco Central e da os banqueiros e os trabalhadores bancrios, aos quais,  sempre exigido, expectvel, uma postura eticamente ntegra, deontologicamente profissional para a contnua edificao, solidificao e melhoria do Sistema Financeiro Angolano, atendendo assim, por um lado, aos desgnios e expectativas dos agentes econmicos, famlias e investidores e, por outro lado, das suas instituies patronais, salvaguardando os interesses dos depositantes, tendo em linha de conta, o papel que os bancos devem desempenhar para o bem-estar da sociedade e consequentemente para o desenvolvimento sustentvel da economia do Pas.  bem verdade que alguns desafios persistem. Entretanto,  importante aqui mencionar que a performance dos bancos, os nveis e o estado do crdito  economia tm sido devidamente acompanhados pelo Banco Nacional de Angola, com a implementao de medidas e mecanismos que todos vs tm acompanhado, assegurando o cumprimento no s das boas prticas internacionais, mas tambm a Estabilidade Financeira e do nvel geral dos preos. Apesar dos constrangimentos que a nossa economia atravessa desde meados de 2014, decorrentes da desacelerao do preo do Barril do petrleo, que limitou a disponibilidade de Divisas, a inflao tem vindo a desacelerar, aps ter aumentado em mdia cerca de 3% em 2016, e menos de 2% at Julho de 2017, passando de 41,9% em Dezembro do transato ano para 31,89% em Julho de 2017, fruto da Poltica monetria restritiva do BNA. As reclamaes dos depositantes, consumidores de produtos e servios financeiros tm igualmente merecido uma particular ateno do Banco Nacional de Angola. Entretanto, reiteramos o trabalho conjunto da indstria Bancria com o Banco Central. Os trabalhadores bancrios: Devem pautar-se por padres elevados de tica profissional e evitar situaes susceptveis de originar conflitos de interesses, cabendo-lhes, designadamente, abster- se de participar em qualquer operao econmica ou financeira que possam prejudicar a sua independncia ou imparcialidade. Devem estar conscientes da importncia dos respectivos deveres e responsabilidades para com a sua instituio patronal, tendo em conta as expectativas dos cidados e das instituies relativamente  sua conduta, dentro de padres socialmente aceites, e comportar-se de modo a reforar a confiana do Sistema Financeiro Angolano. Devem ainda estar cientes de que, como regra, toda e qualquer informao que obtenham ou resulte do desempenho das suas tarefas, so consideradas Confidenciais, pelo que  expressamente proibido divulgar ou dar a conhecer as mesmas,  pessoas alheias, sob pena de ser disciplinar e criminalmente responsabilizado. Deste modo, entendemos que seja necessrio que haja mais investimento no capital humano, no s em formaes especializadas, mas sobretudo de tica e deontologia profissional, destinado aos trabalhadores bancrios, aos quais apela-se que cumpram escrupulosamente os Cdigos de Conduta das suas instituies. A tica e a deontologia profissional constituem ferramenta fundamental, para a gesto s e prudente dos bancos. Da o tema ter sido escolhido para o encontro de hoje. Meus senhores e minhas senhoras, Distintos convidados; Reconhecemos que h ainda um caminho a percorrer, porm, temos de reconhecer os ganhos alcanados para o alcance da estabilidade do sistema financeiro. Vamos todos continuar a trabalhar juntos, rumo  adequao do nosso Sistema Bancrio s melhores prticas internacionais. Finalizo, agradecendo a ateno dispensada e reafirmando a nossa confiana de que, unidos no esforo comum de edificao de um sistema bancrio dinmico, seguramente daremos uma contribuio valiosa para que o nosso Pas trilhe com xito os desafios existentes, assegurando a estabilidade macroeconmica e financeira, face s adversidades do cenrio externo de reduo dos preos do Barril de Petrleo, para a consolidao da diversificao da economia, atravs do crdito. Title: Speech at the opening of the training on Microcredit for Religious Entities Registered with the Council of Christian Churches in Angola - CICA
text: Speech by the Administrator of the National Bank of Angola, Ana Paula do Patrocinio Rodrigues, at opening of microcredit training for religious entities registered in the Council of Cristas Churches in Angola - CICA Speech by the Administrator of the National Bank of Angola, Ana Paula do Patrocinio Rodrigues, at opening up microcredit training for Religious Entities Registered in the Council of Cristas Churches in Angola - CICA Excellencies Madam General Secretary of the Council of Christian Churches in Angola Reverend Ecclesiastical Authorities Lords Shepherds Your Excellese Members of the C.A. of the National Bank of Angola Distinguished Guests; Ladies and Gentlemen On behalf of the National Bank of Angola, we would like to welcome all our representatives of the religious institutions present in this microcredit training session for religious entities promoted by the BNA, with the collaboration of the KiXICREDITO Microcredit Society, SA. In the context of the monetary policy of the National Bank of Angola whose objective is the preservation of the national level, price stability and the prosperity of angolan families, the BNA has drawn up a plan for the promotion and promotion of microcredit and Personal Credit in Angola aimed at ensuring access to services training and training facilities, the creation of self-business, micro-enterprises, and microcredit. Accordingly, the National Bank of Angola, within its competences, intends to promote, promote and monitor Microcredit operations based on social responsibility and the empowerment of Microcredit Societies, in partnership with with religious entities. In Angola, Microcredit emerged in 1999 through the government program that was first phase, to the families that are victims of the war. The first microcredit institution formally established in Angola in 2008 was the Kixicredito, the largest, in terms of geographical distribution in the territory national. The legislative instrument that approved and regulates the activities of Microcredit Companies and lays the groundwork for its exercise of supervision of Institutions is Presidential Decree No. 28/11 of February 2 In quantitative terms, the maximum amount allowed today for the granting of microcredit Individual or Solidarity Group is Kz 1,000,000.00 (One million Kwanzas). In 2008 and May 2017, the number of authorised financial institutions increased from 1 to 33; or number of financial institutions in activity from 1 to 7 and the number of agencies from 6 to 113. There are also in the Angolan Financial System, 4 Banks engaged in Microcredit activities, the know bpc, bci, sol bank, micro finance bank. In 2008 and May 2017, the number of microcredit companies' clients increased from 8,000 to 126,091, as well as Kz's credit portfolio volume 530.74 million for Kz 9,154.36 million. Excellencies Ladies Gentlemen As for the above, we conclude that Microcredit, although it is a non-high amount credit, social and economic benefits of great impact angolan economy, such as: The creation of a sustainable activity capable of generating a surplus of income that compensates for the borrowed capital; The small investment that creates a business and the job itself; Entrepreneurship facilitation Promoting financial inclusion Encouraging the formalisation of the informal economy Increased tax revenue Improving the quality of life of our populations Reducing poverty, creating jobs and incomes for families Illustrious participants Finally, and not least, we welcome Kixicredito's collaboration with the based on his experience, participates in this training programme promotion of Microcredit, as well as religious entities, for having accepted the invitation formulated by the National Bank of Angola. Well be all and thank you very much Aug. 24. 2017

Em Angola, o Microcrdito surgiu em 1999 atravs do programa governamental que foi destinado, numa primeira fase, s famlias vtimas da guerra. A primeira instituio de microcrdito formalmente constituda em Angola em 2008, foi a Kixicrdito, a maior, em termos de distribuio geogrfica no territrio nacional. Title: Opening Speech at the Savings Fair - "Savings Week"
text: Public Interventions Opening Speech of the Deputy Governor of the BNA, Suzana Camacho Monteiro, Savings Fair - "Savings Week" Opening Speech of the Deputy Governor of the BNA, Suzana Camacho Monteiro, Savings - "Savings Week" Your Excellese Youth Secretary Very honorable Coordinator of the Financial Literacy Project in Education Very honorable Members of the Board of Directors of the National Bank of Angola; Distinguished Presidents, Directors and Heads of Banking Financial Institutions and not Bank; Worthy National Directors, the Youth House, The Heads of Participating Schools and the Winning Schools of the National Education Education Competition Financial; Worthy Traditional Authorities; Worthy Parents and the dear winners of the National Education Competition Financial; Esteemed Colleagues and Guests, Ladies and gentlemen; It is with great satisfaction that I proceed today to the opening of this event. The holding of this Fair in "Savings Week" in allusion to October 31, day World Savings Bank, is part of the celebrations of 05 November, commemorative date of the 41st anniversary of the National Bank of Angola, under the motto "SAVE AND INVEST SAFELY" thus marking, once again, the relevance attributed to the theme of savings and the contribution it makes to the well-being of angolan families and the socio-economic development of the country. We intend to involve all partners in the reflection of this important theme. We take the opportunity to remember on the need for economic actors to come together the mission of saving so that this action is a practice in our society, influencing different economic actors and institutions, taking into account the account that the future of all of us begins with savings. Our aspiration is that with this event, we can promote or enable greater access to information on financial products and services appropriate to the savings, investment and financing needs of citizens, a key factor in the financial inclusion strategy. Thus, the National Bank of Angola intends to continue to develop strategies that contribute to more efficient management of the family budget and the reduction of recourse to the informal financial services sector, which are not regulated or supervised and therefore less secure. MY LADIES AND GENTLEMEN; The primary function of financial intermediation is to capture deposits from economic agents with surplus revenues and make them available to agents, who need financial resources to make investments. Households by transferring part of their present consumption into the future (i.e. by making savings), will be wanting a better future. This attitude is important not only at individual level, but also at the collective level, and can contribute to the reduction of the country's poverty rate, as it improves our future living conditions, ensures access to better education, a better level of assistance and medical and drug products and consequently contributes, in large part, to growth and economic development. Saving means not spending everything you earn. The habit of saving demonstrates the responsibility individuals in relation to the objectives set, their ability to plan their future in a timely manner, presenting individual benefits as they allows individuals to develop projects and against unexpected events, in addition to providing greater discipline, tranquility and stability in the present and future of families, thereby contributing to the reduction of collective (family) risks in the future. It should be noted that increasing savings levels allow funding to be channelled into the financing of investment and the development of economic activities contribute to achieving the objective of diversifying our economy. In economic doctrine, there has been a consensus that more investment is needed to ensure higher growth in the long term and, consequently, greater well-being of families. Comparative studies on the subject show that the most developed are those that have levels of savings High. Therefore, one of the most effective channels of increasing the production of goods and services of the economy is to stimulate savings and therefore investments. As you can see, SAVINGS turns out to be one of the key requirements for there is greater socio-economic well-being. Pursuing the achievement of a more inclusive financial system presupposes the development of programmes that dissemine financial literacy, increase the accessibility to the financial services network and promote the development of financial solutions contribute to improving the living conditions of each inhabitant. In this context, within the framework of the Millennium Development Goals, improving access to financial services in developing countries has become a important objective of public policies. This objective recognises that economic growth can be accelerated by deepening and widening the financial services. Our country is no exception! Thus, in the National Development Plan 2017-2022, the executive mentions the need for financial system to act in such a way as to ensure the well-being and economic and social progress of communities, including smallfarmers and holders of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises, both in urban areas, rural areas, thereby promoting the continuous improvement of the levels of inclusion financial crisis in the country. It is on this path that the National Bank of Angola has developed Financial Inclusion Policies consistent, capable of providing a favourable environment for families to deal with financial issues, compatible with the various conditions and existing needs. Among the measures undertaken by the National Bank of Angola, we can mention the publication of a set of regulations regulating consumer protection financial products and services, the activity of the banking agent, the general duties of information, standardisation and disclosure of the price, the strategy of implementation of the Mobile Payment System in Angola, the incorporation of Microfinance and so many others. As part of the strategy of banking the Angolan population, we highlight the creation, in 2011, of the simplified accounts targeted at the underage population income  Bankita accounts, which allow the opening of bank accounts with a minimum value of Cem Kwanzas (Kz 100.00), upon presentation of any personal identification document. These accounts have two natures, order and term account. It should be noted that, after 6 six years of existence of the "Bankita accounts", in the First Half of 2017, a total of bankita accounts opened of approximately 519,000 accounts, which contributed 5.9% to the Angolan Banking Rate, estimated in this period by about 52%. On the other hand, about 43,000 accounts have already migrated to conventional accounts, becoming customers with access to a wider range of financial products, including credit. These data indicate that the Program implemented by the BNA for the opening of the "Bankita Accounts", by its characteristics and minimum requirements, has served as a access to the banking financial system, enabling the capture of savings and the integration of segment of the population in the banking financial system, positiveimpact on the financing of economic activities. Overall, deposits are the largest source of fundraising for institutions Banking Financial Institutions, representing about 80% of the liabilities total. This trend is a positive factor in that it opens up an opportunity for the banking system can create more and more products and innovative savings collection services. We cannot fail to mention the specific initiatives in the field of education and financial inclusion, in particular, awareness-raising and training campaigns such as lectures, the preparation and dissemination of information leaflets, the international financial inclusion, the means of training financial distance - the Consumer Ombudsman Portal for Financial Products and Services, and underline initiatives in schools, such as the Project for Insertion of Financial Literacy Contents in the Angolan Education System. The partnership between the National Bank of Angola and the Ministry of Education, by fully assuming the responsibility of this arduous task, sought to respond the challenges and expectations that have enabled the Content Insertion Project to be Financial Literacy in the Education System became a reality. The Project for the Insertion of Financial Literacy Content into the National Education System involved public schools of the various subsystems, namely General, Professional Technician and Teacher Training, who already implement the Project. Currently The National Bank of Angola and the Ministry of Education have accompanied by preliminary statistics of the monitoring of this Project that took place from May to July 2017, at national level, with a coverage of the training in the order of 3,261 Teachers and 302,387 students from 7th to 12th Class. We understand that the transmission of Financial Literacy content to children and young people country, contributes to the better prepared generation of adults that are best prepared for the the management of its financial resources and the relationship with the financial system This is a process, culminating in the award of the National School Competition award for Financial Education. This is how, today we have the satisfaction of have with us the top three (three) from the following provinces: Zaire, national pride of the attribution of classification as Cultural Heritage of Humanity; Namibe, and Cunene, DEAR GUESTS, MY LADIES AND GENTLEMEN The partnership between the National Bank of Angola and the Ministry of Education will continue, the importance of Financial Literacy Teaching in angola, motivating young people and adolescents to increase knowledge and skills essential for the management of finances in their daily lives, including Savings habits. Last and not least, I reiterate that with this fair we want to create an environment conducive and favorable for the knowledge of some solutions of savings, products and services made available by Angolan financial institutions, promoting responsible financial attitudes, to stimulate better choices, cost weighting and lower risks. " To all economic actors, in particular youth, rather than keeping in home your savings, we call for deposit in the banks because these individual savings, which are intended for investment, support the economy in fostering promotion of growth and economic development in the country." Thus, I declare open the "Savings Week Fair". Thank you so much. Oct. 30 2017

Aproveitamos para relembrar sobre a necessidade dos agentes econmicos juntarem-se  misso da poupana para que esta aco constitua uma prtica na nossa sociedade, influenciando diferentes intervenientes econmicos e instituies, tendo em conta que o futuro de todos ns comea com a poupana. A nossa aspirao  que com este evento, possamos promover ou possibilitar o maior acesso  informao de produtos e servios financeiros adequados s necessidades de poupana, de investimento e de financiamento dos cidados, factor-chave na estratgia de incluso financeira. MINHAS SENHORAS E MEUS SENHORES; A funo primria da intermediao financeira consiste em captar depsitos de agentes econmicos com receitas superavitrias e coloc-los  disposio dos agentes deficitrios, que precisam de recursos financeiros para realizarem investimentos. Neste contexto, no mbito dos objectivos do Desenvolvimento do Milnio, melhorar o acesso aos servios financeiros nos pases em desenvolvimento tornou-se um importante objectivo das polticas pblicas. Este objectivo reconhece que o crescimento econmico pode ser acelerado pelo aprofundamento e alargamento dos servios financeiros. O nosso pas no  uma excepo! Assim, no Plano Nacional de Desenvolvimento 2017-2022, o executivo faz meno  necessidade do sistema financeiro actuar de modo a garantir o bem-estar e o progresso econmico e social das comunidades, incluindo os pequenos agricultores e detentores de micro, pequenas e mdias empresas, tanto nas reas urbanas, como nas zonas rurais, promovendo, deste modo, a contnua melhoria dos nveis de incluso financeira no Pas.  nesta senda que o Banco Nacional de Angola tem desenvolvido Polticas de Incluso Financeira consistentes, capazes de proporcionar um ambiente favorvel para as famlias lidarem com as questes financeiras, compatveis com as diversas condies e necessidades existentes. Por outro lado, cerca de 43.000 contas j migraram para contas convencionais, tornando-se clientes com acesso  um leque mais vasto de produtos financeiros, incluindo o crdito. Estes dados indicam que o Programa implementado pelo BNA para a abertura das Contas Bankita, pelas suas caractersticas e requisitos mnimos, tem servido de canal de acesso ao sistema financeiro bancrio, permitindo a captao da poupana e a integrao deste segmento da populao no sistema financeiro bancrio, capaz de impactar positivamente sobre o financiamento das actividades econmicas. Em termos globais, os depsitos constituem a maior fonte de captao de recursos das Instituies Financeiras Bancrias, representando cerca de 80% do passivo total. Esta tendncia representa um factor positivo na medida em que abre uma oportunidade para que o sistema bancrio possa criar cada vez mais produtos e servios de captao de poupanas inovadoras. No podemos deixar de citar as iniciativas especficas no mbito da educao e incluso financeira, nomeadamente, as campanhas de sensibilizao e formao financeira, tais como as palestras, a elaborao e divulgao de folhetos informativos, os fruns internacionais de incluso financeira, os meios de formao financeira  distncia - o Portal da Provedoria do Consumidor de Produtos e Servios Financeiros, e, sublinhar as iniciativas nas escolas, tais como, o Projecto de Insero de Contedos de Literacia Financeira no Sistema de Ensino Angolano. A parceria entre o Banco Nacional de Angola e o Ministrio da Educao, ao assumirem na plenitude a responsabilidade desta rdua tarefa, procurou responder condignamente aos desafios e s expectativas que permitiram que o Projecto de Insero de Contedos de Literacia Financeira no Sistema de Ensino se tornasse uma realidade. O Projecto de Insero de Contedos de Literacia Financeira no Sistema nacional de ensino, envolveu escolas pblicas dos vrios subsistemas, nomeadamente Ensino Geral, Tcnico Profissional e Formao de Professores, que j implementam o Projecto. Actualmente, o Banco Nacional de Angola e o Ministrio da Educao tm acompanhado as estatsticas preliminares do monitoramento do referido Projecto ocorrido de Maio a Julho de 2017,  nvel Nacional, com uma cobertura da formao na ordem dos 3.261 Professores e de 302.387 alunos da 7  12 Classe. Entendemos que, a transmisso de contedos da Literacia Financeira s crianas e aos jovens do nosso Pas, contribui para que tenhamos uma gerao de adultos melhor preparada no que respeita  administrao dos seus recursos financeiros e  relao com o sistema financeiro Trata-se de um processo, que culmina com a atribuio do prmio do Concurso Escolar Nacional de Educao Financeira.  assim que, hoje temos a es satisfao de ter conosco os 3 (trs) primeiros classificados, provenientes das seguintes provncias: Zaire, orgulho nacional da atribuio de classificao como Patrimnio Cultural da Humanidade; Namibe, e Cunene, CAROS CONVIDADOS, MINHAS SENHORAS E MEUS SENHORES A parceria entre o Banco Nacional de Angola e o Ministrio da Educao ter continuidade, inaltecendo-se a importncia do Ensino da Literacia Financeira em Angola, motivando os jovens e os adolescentes, a elevarem os conhecimentos e as habilidades essenciais para a gesto das finanas no seu quotidiano, incluindo os hbitos de Poupana. Por ltimo e no menos importante, reitero que com esta feira pretendemos criar um ambiente propcio e favorvel para o conhecimento de algumas solues de poupana, de produtos e servios disponibilizados pelas instituies financeiras Angolanas, promovendo atitudes financeiras responsveis, para estimular melhores escolhas, ponderao de custos e menores riscos.   todos os agentes econmicos, em particular a juventude, ao invs de guardarem em casa as suas poupanas, apelamos que depositem nos bancos pois essas poupanas individuais, que so destinadas ao investimento, suportam a economia no fomento do emprego e na promoo do crescimento e no desenvolvimento econmico do Pas. Title: Opening speech at the 5th Meeting on Information Technology Governance and Business Continuity Management of SADC Central Banks
text: Opening speech of the BNA Administrator, Beatriz Ferreira Andrade dos Santos, at the 5th Meeting On Information Technology Governance and Continuity Management of SADC Central Banks Business Opening speech of the BNA Administrator, Beatriz Ferreira Andrade dos Santos, in the 5th Meeting on Governance of Business Continuity Information and Management SADC Central Banks Honourable Delegates of the Central Banks of SADC, Dear Directors and Directors, Ladies and gentlemen, Ladies and gentlemen, Welcome to 5th Meeting on Governance of Information Technologies and Business Continuity Management of SADC Central Banks First of all, I hope that the visiting delegations have made a good trip and have had a great arrival in Angola. I also hope that the conditions of accommodation, work and other services that the National Bank angola has made available to you for the development of of your work over the next four days are to your liking and that you will meet the expectations for this meeting. The National Bank of Angola and its Board of Directors, like all banks SADC's Central Power Plants, is in the notion of the weight that information has in modern organisations and the new forms of organisation that they promote, allowing you to have control over the organization's processes. Accordingly, it is indispensable to ensure the success of the business, the Governance of Information Technologies should therefore be considered as the management, but, above all, equivalent to a set of practices by which the should guide the COs Leaders of Organizations in the decision with a view to achieving the organisation's objectives. I want to highlight here that IT governance means more productivity and better use of the technological resources in which the organization has invested and, therefore, these are our ambitions. Implementing an IT Governance programme is to implement actions that are to implement a alignment of the sector with the guidelines and objectives of the organisation and is to develop and implement a set of structured practices that optimise the sector to serve the purposes of the organization. Talking about IT Governance is talking about standards and relationships built in a structured way and this requires the participation not only of technical professionals, but also from professionals of various levels. Thus, the idea is to ensure, with the involvement of all, effective control of the processes, especially with regard to information security. The purpose of implementing IT Governance is to get the organization to develop its it processes in a fluid way, with synchrony, for example, in other words, to function as gears. It is also the objective of IT Governance to minimise risks, as organisations that achieve the success in their management processes work under the risk minimisation perspective. On the other hand, Business Continuity Management aims to ensure the continuity of operations of the organization in the event of an unavailability resources that support the performance of operations. Through the Business Continuity Management process, the organization aims to know and document their processes in order to measure, through the Analysis of risks, the risks to which they are exposed and, in this way, develop plans for both a crisis as to recover if it occurs. Developing a good business continuity plan will reduce common stress and confusion in a time of crisis, allowing the return of activities is carried out in a more agile manner. It is expected that a Central Bank will continue to develop its activity, regardless of the occurrence of a disaster, and, to that end, must implement mechanisms that ensure the resilience of their critical functions in order to: Ensuring the well-being and safety of its workers; Protect reputation and image of solidity and trust; Comply with legal, regulatory and contractual obligations. Integrate Business Continuity Management (GCN) into culture and its management processes in line with its risk management strategy operational. That said, it is clear the importance of organizations having and maintaining a good Continuity Plan Business. Finally, I would like to call for the discussions and ideas to be addressed at this meeting to produce quantitative and qualitative results to ensure the effective implementation of IT Governance and Business Continuity Management in our central banks of the SADC region. We also hope that this meeting will serve as a genuine means of communication for the knowledge sharing in each Central Bank matters to be dealt with here. Finally, I wish you all good work, good stay, good fun and good return to family. 11 Jun 2018
text_original: Home Publicaes e Media Intervenes Pblicas Discurso de abertura da Administradora do BNA, Beatriz Ferreira Andrade dos Santos, no 5. Encontro sobre Governao das Tecnologias de Informao e Gesto da Continuidade de Negcio dos Bancos Centrais da SADC Discurso de abertura da Administradora do BNA, Beatriz Ferreira Andrade dos Santos, no 5. Encontro sobre Governao das Tecnologias de Informao e Gesto da Continuidade de Negcio dos Bancos Centrais da SADC Excelentssimos Senhores Delegados dos Bancos Centrais da SADC, Estimados Directores e Directoras, Caros Colegas, Senhores e Senhoras, Bem-vindos ao 5. Encontro sobre Governao das Tecnologias de Informao e Gesto da Continuidade de Negcio dos Bancos Centrais da SADC Antes de tudo, espero que as delegaes visitantes tenham feito uma boa viagem e tenham tido uma ptima chegada a Angola. Espero igualmente que as condies de alojamento, trabalho e outros servios que o Banco Nacional de Angola colocou  vossa disposio para o desenvolvimento do vosso trabalho ao longo destes prximos 4 dias sejam do vosso agrado e que vo ao encontro das expectativas para este encontro. O Banco Nacional de Angola e o seu Conselho de Administrao,  semelhana de todos os Bancos Centrais da SADC, tem a noo do peso que as Tecnologias de Informao tm nas organizaes modernas e das novas formas de organizao que estas promovem, permitindo ter controlo sobre os processos da organizao. Nesta conformidade, torna-se indispensvel para garantir o sucesso do negcio, a Governao das Tecnologias de Informao deve ser pensada, portanto, como a gesto da gesto, equivalendo, no entanto e sobretudo, a um conjunto de prticas pelas quais se devem orientar os COs Dirigentes de Organizaes nas tomadas de deciso com vista ao alcance dos objectivos da organizao. Quero aqui destacar que a Governao das TI significa mais produtividade e melhor aproveitamento dos recursos tecnolgicos nos quais a organizao investiu e, portanto, estas so as nossas ambies. Colocar em prtica um programa de Governao das TI,  implementar aces que primem por um alinhamento do sector com as diretrizes e objectivos da organizao e  desenvolver e aplicar um conjunto de prticas estruturadas que optimizem a actuao do sector para servir os propsitos da organizao. Falar de Governao das TI  falar de padres e de relacionamentos construdos de forma estruturada e tal requer a participao no s dos profissionais tcnicos, mas igualmente de profissionais de vrios nveis. Assim, a ideia  garantir, com o envolvimento de todos, um controlo efectivo dos processos, principalmente no que diz respeito  segurana das informaes. O propsito da implementao da Governao das TI  fazer com que a organizao desenvolva os seus processos em TI de uma forma fluda, com sincronia, por outras palavras, a funcionar como fossem engrenagens.  tambm objectivo da Governao das TI minimizar riscos, j que as organizaes que alcanam o sucesso nos seus processos de gesto trabalham sob a perspectiva da minimizao dos riscos. Por outro lado, a Gesto da Continuidade de Negcios tem como objectivo garantir a continuidade das operaes da organizao, caso ocorra uma indisponibilidade prolongada dos recursos que do suporte  realizao das operaes. Atravs do processo de Gesto da Continuidade de Negcio, a organizao visa conhecer e documentar os seus processos de forma a medir, atravs da Anlise de Riscos, os riscos aos quais os mesmos esto expostos e, desta forma, desenvolver planos tanto para evitar uma crise como para se recuperar, caso esta ocorra. A elaborao de um bom plano de continuidade de negcio ir reduzir o estresse e a confuso comuns num momento de crise, permitindo que o retorno das actividades seja realizado de forma mais gil.  expectvel que um Banco Central continue a desenvolver a sua actividade, independentemente da ocorrncia de um desastre, e, para o efeito, deve implementar mecanismos que assegurem a resilincia das suas funes crticas de forma a: Assegurar o bem-estar e a segurana dos seus trabalhadores; Proteger a reputao e imagem de solidez e confiana; Cumprir as obrigaes legais, regulamentares e contratuais. Integrar a Gesto da Continuidade do Negcio (GCN) na cultura e nos seus processos de gesto corporativa, em linha com a sua estratgia de gesto do risco operacional. Dito isto, fica clara a importncia das organizaes terem e manterem um bom Plano de Continuidade de Negcios. Para terminar, Gostaria de apelar para que os debates e as ideias que sero abordados neste encontro, produzam resultados quantitativos e qualitativos para garantirem a implementao efectiva da Governao das TI e da Gesto da Continuidade de Negcio nos nossos respectivos Bancos Centrais da regio da SADC. Esperamos, igualmente, que este encontro sirva como um verdadeiro meio de comunicao para a partilha de conhecimento existente em cada Banco Central relativamente s matrias que aqui sero tratadas. Finalmente, desejo a todos bom trabalho, boa estadia, boa diverso e bom regresso ao seio familiar. Title: Speech at the closing of the VIII Banking Forum
text: Public Interventions Address of the Governor of the National Bank of Angola, Jose de Lima Massano, at the close of the VIII Banking Forum Speech by the Governor of the National Bank of Angola, Jose de Lima Massano, at the close of the VIII Banking Forum Mr. Carlos Rosado, Director of The Expansion Journal, Distinguished guests, Ladies and gentlemen, First of all, I would like to thank us for the invitation made to us to close the of this event and express a word of recognition to the Direction of The Expansion Journal by once again bringing together for debate experts, analysts, managers, academics and people interested in current issues economic and financial situation. During this morning, I know that part of the motivations that led us to change the regime exchange rate at the beginning of this year, which can be summed up in our inability to sustain the monetary policy anchored in the foreign currency when it depends, in the our case, in about 95% of a single product of price does not depend on our influence on the markets in which it is traded. On the other hand, it was no longer possible to maintain a framework for the degradation of international reserves aimed at economic growth, price stability or the normality of commercial transactions with the outside world. The Macroeconomic Stability Plan seeks to eliminate the distortions that condition the maintenance of a stable and more favourable basis for the progress of the economy. The adjustment of the foreign exchange market joins another set of structural reforms and, it is relevant, because we are an open economy and still very dependent on external factors. In fact, the widespread fall in the price of export commodities recorded since mid-2010 2014, shook the paths and development options of emerging economies and required the adoption of corrective measures aimed at the protection of solvency and minimisation of social impacts. In Angola it was no different, but the initial process of currency devaluation in 2015 and 2016, will have been affected by the worsening of the fiscal conditions that will have conditioned the action of monetary policy, not achieving the desired rebalancing the value of the national currency, nor price stability, which justified the replacement of a fixed exchange rate regime. Without any desprimor to the merits, it is certain that in December 2017, the Kwanza was among the 4 the world's most overvalued currencies, against a backdrop of accelerated degradation of international reserves and the accumulation of responsibilities in the face of outside. Despite serving only as a barometer of the progress of the formal foreign exchange market, the differential between the formal and informal market, reaching 150%, now has direct impact on price formation and the intensive development of unconventional execution of payments abroad, and may put into not only the country's commitments in the context of combating money laundering and financing of terrorism, but also the sanity of the and the viability of a market economy that is defined and with predictability. The new exchange rate regime, however, is not in itself the solution to all the evils affecting our economy. In fact, and as we often say in management, there are no perfect models, there are those that work. And in this case, they should operate in alignment with the economic development objectives contained in the governance advisory programmes. According to the IMF, there are 10 categories of currency models, but can be summarized in three: fixed, flexible and hybrid. The arguments in favour of one or more others are many and very heated, just as we saw here when the announcement of the end of the fixation kwanza to the dollar and the euro. Therefore, the option for a floating exchange rate regime does not only bring good news. It also requires sacrifices, both at the business and personal level. We will have the market dictating the balance of the currency price, but the market also has its imperfections and we may have a stake in the currency, for example information asymmetry between economic agents, less assertive perception of information policy decisions or even by feeling of lower confidence in the economy. But still, the path of normalisation of economic life must be made so that the gains social services are lasting. Economic growth cycles have longer and, to this, a macroeconomic stability framework is crucial. We must gain greater capacity to protect international reserves and ensure the external solvency of the economy. To this end, the scarce currencies of we have to be used efficiently and economically. They should be at the service of the development and construction of the being-social. Therefore, while we have overcome our institutional and market organisation limitations, we keep some restrictions on the movement of the current account balance of payments, avoiding greater pressure sprees on the currency and on the reserves of International. Raising awareness of our limitations should be general so that together we can overcome. We also have a high demand for foreign exchange for coverage import of goods that the country is able to produce. In the first quarter of 2018, for example, food imports were usd 560 million, despite representing a drop of 30% compared to the same period in 2017, if guided by the demand, which remains high at the end of this year we may not be far from the approximately USD 3.3 billion of food imports verified in 2017. The monthly demand for foreign exchange for the non-oil sector, for its part, is above Usd 300 million, however much of this demand could be domestic production, particularly in the beverage sector. What we want to convey here is that we must better exploit the country's potential for security of investments, because we have this capacity. We should look at currencies as one of the tools for fostering collective well-being and not as an end in itself. And it is also in this sense that a balanced and efficient format of access to the foreign exchange market is sought. I take this opportunity to note that we are in the early stages of resolving the outstanding foreign exchange previous years and that, as of 31 December 2017, were valued at about USD 3 billion. Now, in July, we will regularize the the amounts claimed by the airlines which, of the USD 540 million identified as due earlier this year, are now estimated at less than usd 100 million. In the informal market, the Kwanza is appreciated and the exchange rate differential between markets tends to convergence. Waiting lists at commercial banks are relationship with external suppliers is normalised. But the adjustment continues. Phase 2 of the New Operational Framework of the Foreign Exchange Market aims to increase the number of foreign currency bidders, in addition to the BNA, and as well as as we have a greater dynamism in the foreign exchange market, particularly in the clearance of the exchange. In the particular case of our market, the National Treasury, oil operators and non-petroleum exporters are those who are able to participate in on the supply side. This step will also be implemented in a phased manner, so that in a first time we will have non-oil exporters by September and, subsequently, the re-entry of oil operators. With regard to the clearance of the exchange rate, we intend to capture the daily movements of purchase and sale of foreign exchange that occur in the market and is no longer exchange gear formed solely by holding weekly auctions organized by the BNA. In the meantime, we are also working on other conditions that should precede any changes significant to the way the foreign exchange market operates. The stability of our banking system is fundamental to re-re-re-easing trust in banking and ensure efficient intermediation of foreign exchange resources available and undisturbed to the normal functioning of the economy. In the coming days we will publish new rules to be adopted in settlement proceedings for import and export of goods, seeking to provide greater security in relations with external counterparties, ensuring both the payment of what is due and the effective entry of goods into the country, in the meantime, Acquired. The recently published regulation on the new minimum limit for the share capital of banks and limits on the exchange rate position, as well as the effective implementation of risk-based supervision, are some of the measures aimed at strengthening the our banking system. All these measures, as well as the continuous strengthening of the institutional capacity of the National angola, should ensure an environment conducive to changes to be made to the operational framework of the foreign exchange market are consistent with the with regard to the contribution of the banking sector to the economic and social development of our country. I end by thanking, once again, the invitation that was made to me wishing all the best professional successes and wisdom to overcome the difficulties we still face as a country that wants to develop in a harmonious and inclusive way. Thank you very much. 29 Jun 2018

Durante esta manh, sei que se abordou j parte das motivaes que nos levaram a alterar o regime cambial no incio deste ano, que se podem resumir na nossa incapacidade de suster a poltica monetria ancorada na moeda estrangeira quando esta depende, no nosso caso, em cerca de 95% de um nico produto de exportao e cujo preo no depende da nossa influncia nos mercados em que  transacionado. Por outro lado, j no era possvel manter um quadro de degradao das reservas internacionais visando o crescimento da economia, a estabilidade de preos ou a normalidade das transaces comerciais com o exterior. O Plano de Estabilidade Macroeconmica procura eliminar as distores que condicionam a manuteno de uma base estvel e mais favorvel para o andamento da economia. O ajustamento do mercado cambial junta-se a outro conjunto de reformas estruturais e,  relevante, por sermos uma economia aberta e ainda muito dependente de factores externos. Na verdade, a queda generalizada do preo das commodities de exportao registada desde meados de 2014, abalou os caminhos e opes de desenvolvimento das economias emergentes e obrigou  adopo de medidas correctivas visando a proteco da solvabilidade externa e a minimizao de impactos sociais. Em Angola no foi diferente, mas o processo inicial de desvalorizao da moeda nos anos de 2015 e 2016, ter sido afectado pelo agravamento das condies fiscais que tero condicionado a aco da poltica monetria, no se conquistando o desejado reequilbrio do valor da moeda nacional, nem de estabilidade de preos, o que ter justificado a reposio de um regime de taxa de cmbio fixa. Sem qualquer desprimor para o mrito, certo  que, em Dezembro de 2017, o Kwanza estava entre as 4 moedas mais sobrevalorizadas do mundo, ante um cenrio de acelerada degradao das reservas internacionais e de acumulao de responsabilidades perante o exterior. Apesar de servir apenas como barmetro do andamento do mercado cambial formal, o diferencial entre o mercado formal e informal, ao atingir 150%, passou a ter impacto directo na formao de preos e no desenvolvimento intenso de solues no convencionais de execuo de pagamentos ao exterior, podendo colocar em causa no apenas os compromissos do pas no quadro do combate ao branqueamento de capitais e financiamento do terrorismo, mas tambm a sanidade do sistema financeiro e a viabilidade de uma de economia de mercado que se quer regrada e com previsibilidade. O novo regime cambial, entretanto, no  em si a soluo para todos os males que afectam a nossa economia. Na verdade, e como dizemos muitas vezes em gesto, no h modelos perfeitos, h os que funcionam. E, neste caso, devem funcionar em alinhamento com os objectivos de desenvolvimento econmico constantes dos programas orientadores de governao. De acordo como o FMI, existem 10 categorias de modelos cambiais, mas podem ser resumidos em trs: fixo, flexvel e hbrido. Os argumentos a favor de um ou de outro so muitos e acalorados, tal e qual como aqui assistimos aquando do anncio do fim da fixao do Kwanza ao Dlar e ao Euro. Portanto, a opo por um regime de cmbio flutuante no traz apenas boas notcias. Exige tambm alguns sacrifcios, quer a nvel empresarial, quer a nvel pessoal. Teremos o mercado a ditar o equilbrio do preo da moeda, mas o mercado tambm tem as suas imperfeies e poderemos ter uma presso sobre a moeda, por exemplo, por assimetria de informao entre os agentes econmicos, por percepo menos assertiva de decises de poltica ou at mesmo por sentimento de menor confiana na economia. Mas ainda assim, h que fazer o percurso de normalizao da vida econmica para que os ganhos sociais sejam duradouros. Os ciclos de crescimento econmico tm que ser mais longos e, para isso,  determinante um quadro de estabilidade macroeconmica. Devemos conquistar maior capacidade de proteco das reservas internacionais e garantir a solvabilidade externa da economia. Para o efeito, as divisas escassas de que dispomos devem ser utlizadas de modo eficiente e com razoabilidade econmica. Devem ser colocadas ao servio do desenvolvimento e da construo do bem estar-social. Por isso, e enquanto superamos as nossas limitaes institucionais e de organizao do mercado, mantemos algumas restries na movimentao da conta corrente da balana de pagamentos, evitando-se maiores presses sobre a moeda e sobre as reservas internacionais. A consciencializao das nossas limitaes deve ser geral para que, em conjunto, as possamos superar. Temos ainda uma procura por divisas elevada para cobertura de importao de bens que o pas tem condies de produzir. No primeiro trimestre de 2018, por exemplo, a importao de alimentos cifrou-se em Usd 560 milhes, apesar de representar uma queda de 30% comparativamente ao mesmo perodo de 2017, se guiados pela procura, que se mantm alta, no final do presente ano poderemos no estar muito longe dos cerca de Usd 3,3 mil milhes de importao de alimentos verificada em 2017. A procura mensal de divisas para matria-prima para o sector no petrolfero, por seu lado, est acima de Usd 300 milhes, todavia muita dessa procura poderia ser atendida com produo interna, particularmente no sector das bebidas. O que queremos aqui transmitir  que devemos explorar melhor as potencialidades do pas para a segurana dos investimentos, pois temos essa capacidade. Devemos olhar para as divisas como um dos instrumentos para fomentar o bem-estar colectivo e no como um fim em si mesmo. E  tambm com esse sentido que se procura um formato equilibrado e eficiente de acesso ao mercado cambial. Aproveito a ocasio para dar nota que estamos em fase adiantada de resoluo dos pendentes cambiais de anos anteriores e que, a 31 de Dezembro de 2017, estavam avaliados em cerca de Usd 3 mil milhes. Agora, no ms de Julho, regularizaremos a totalidade dos valores reclamados pelas companhias areas que, dos Usd 540 milhes identificados como devidos no incio deste ano, esto hoje calculados em menos de Usd 100 milhes. No mercado informal, o Kwanza aprecia-se e o diferencial da taxa de cmbio entre mercados tende  convergncia. As listas de espera nos bancos comerciais so mais curtas e a relao com os fornecedores externos vai-se normalizando. Mas o ajustamento continua. A 2 Fase do Novo Quadro Operacional do Mercado Cambial tem como objectivo aumentar o nmero de ofertantes de moeda estrangeira, para alm do BNA, e bem como termos um maior dinamismo no mercado cambial, particularmente, no apuramento da taxa de cmbio. No caso particular do nosso mercado, o Tesouro Nacional, as operadoras petrolferas e os exportadores no petrolferos so os que esto em condies de participar do lado da oferta. Esta etapa ser implementada tambm de modo faseado, pelo que num primeiro momento teremos os exportadores no petrolferos at Setembro e, posteriormente, a reentrada das operadoras petrolferas. No que se refere ao apuramento da taxa de cmbio, pretendemos captar os movimentos dirios de compra e venda de divisas que ocorrem no mercado e deixar de ser o cmbio formado unicamente com a realizao de leiles semanais organizados pelo BNA. Entretanto, estamos tambm a trabalhar noutras condies que devem preceder quaisquer alteraes significativas  forma como funciona o mercado cambial. A estabilidade do nosso sistema bancrio  fundamental para a reposio da confiana na banca e garantir uma eficiente intermediao dos recursos cambiais disponveis e sem perturbaes ao normal funcionamento da economia. Faremos publicar, nos prximos dias, novas regras a adoptar em processos de liquidao de importao e exportao de mercadorias, procurando conferir maior segurana nas relaes com contrapartes externas, garantindo tanto o pagamento do que  devido como a efectiva entrada das mercadorias no pas, entretanto, adquiridas. A regulamentao, recentemente publicada, sobre o novo limite mnimo para o capital social dos bancos e limites para a posio cambial, assim como a efectiva implementao de uma superviso baseada no risco, so algumas das medidas que visam robustecer o nosso sistema bancrio. Todas estas medidas, assim como o contnuo reforo da capacidade institucional do Banco Nacional de Angola, devero garantir um ambiente propcio para que as alteraes a serem feitas ao quadro operacional do mercado cambial sejam consequentes no que diz respeito  contribuio do sector bancrio para o desenvolvimento econmico e social do nosso pas. Termino agradecendo, uma vez mais, o convite que me foi formulado desejando a todos os melhores xitos profissionais e sabedoria para superarmos as dificuldades que ainda enfrentamos como pas que se quer desenvolver de forma harmoniosa e inclusiva. Muito obrigado.
