text_original: Home Publicaes e Media Intervenes Pblicas Apresentao de Cumprimentos de Fim de Ano Apresentao de Cumprimentos de Fim de Ano O Governador do Banco Nacional de Angola, Dr. Jos de Lima Massano, procedeu hoje, 21 de Dezembro de 2012, a apresentao de cumprimentos de fim de ano aos responsveis da Instituio e Presidentes dos Conselhos de Administrao de Instituies Financeiras com sede em Angola. Senhores Membros dos rgos Sociais do BNA, Distintos Membros dos Conselhos de Administrao da Banca Comercial, Senhores Directores e Responsveis do BNA, Minhas Senhoras e meus Senhores, Caminhamos para o final do ano 2012, e como reza a tradio do nosso sector, irei tecer algumas palavras sobre aqueles que foram os principais marcos da nossa actividade, bem como perspectivar o exerccio que se segue. No que concerne  economia internacional, assistimos a uma desacelerao do ritmo econmico, evidenciada pela baixa das taxas de crescimento real das economias avanadas e dos pases emergentes e pela diminuio dos nveis do comrcio internacional. Apesar de as autoridades monetrias terem sinalizado um curso mais relaxado da poltica monetria, reduzindo as taxas de juro directoras e injectando liquidez na economia, no se alteraram os sinais de recuperao lenta dos nveis de actividade econmica. A consolidao das finanas pblicas permanece o principal desafio das economias mais avanadas e o objectivo subjacente dos programas de ajustamento em curso em algumas economias da Zona Euro. Na regio da SADC, prev-se em 2012 um crescimento acima da mdia mundial. A implementao de programas no mbito das polticas fiscal e monetria levaram a que, na maior parte das economias da regio, os principais indicadores macroeconmicos se mantivessem estveis. No domnio interno, foi concludo com sucesso o Acordo de Stand-By entre o Executivo Angolano e o Fundo Monetrio Internacional, resultando na disponibilizao da ltima tranche de financiamento. De Realar tambm, os resultados positivos das visitas efectuadas pelas trs agncias de rating que, aps anlise da evoluo dos principais indicadores macroeconmicos, reiteraram a sua opinio de estabilidade econmica de longo-prazo para a economia angolana. A taxa de inflao atingiu no ms de Agosto e pela primeira vez o nvel de um dgito. No final do ms de Novembro de 2012, a inflao acumulada era de 7,96%, enquanto que a inflao dos ltimos 12 meses era de 9,83%. Prev-se que at ao final do ano, a taxa de inflao se mantenha dentro do objectivo determinado pelo Governo, que  de 10%. A execuo coordenada das polticas fiscal e monetria e, a estabilidade da taxa de cmbio so factores determinantes para a estabilidade dos preos na economia angolana. At ao final de Novembro, a taxa de cmbio mdia do mercado primrio tinha depreciado apenas 0,42%. Para a estabilidade da taxa de cmbio contribuiu uma colocao total de divisas, por parte do BNA, de USD 17 mil milhes at 30 de Novembro do corrente ano, 33,5% superior ao montante colocado no perodo homlogo de 2011. O fortalecimento das contas externas, necessrio para a gesto de potenciais choques adversos provenientes do ambiente econmico internacional, foi bem conseguido. Com efeito, at finais de Novembro, tinham sido acumuladas reservas internacionais lquidas no valor de USD 4,7 mil milhes, situando o stock em USD 30,8 mil milhes. No mbito das suas responsabilidades, o BNA consolidou a implementao do Novo Quadro Operacional para a Poltica Monetria. O Comit de Poltica Monetria  CPM  apreciou a evoluo dos indicadores econmicos mundiais, regionais e domsticos e, com base nos mesmos, tomou decises de poltica, privilegiando o alcance do objectivo principal, o da reduo da inflao. A Taxa LUIBOR, nas suas seis maturidades, passou a ser publicada diariamente no site do BNA, constituindo um instrumento de transparncia e de referncia para a formao de expectativas e tomada de decises por parte dos bancos comerciais, das empresas e das famlias. Aps aprovao pela Assembleia Nacional, da Lei do Regime Cambial do Sector Petrolfero, o BNA estabeleceu um cronograma para a entrada em vigor das vrias fases previstas na referida lei. Reunimos regularmente com a Associao das Companhias de Explorao e Produo Petrolfera de Angola (ACEPA) e com os bancos comerciais, com o intuito de se facilitar a operacionalizao do novo regime cambial, o que vem ocorrendo sem quaisquer perturbaes de maior. O sistema bancrio angolano voltou a crescer em 2012. A rede bancria continuou a expandir-se e dispomos j de cerca de 1.155 agncias e dependncias em todo o territrio nacional. Os depsitos totais cresceram, at ao ms de Novembro, cerca de 10%, tendo aqueles denominados em moeda nacional assumido maior peso, representando 52,43% da carteira total. O crdito  economia tinha crescido, no mesmo perodo, em torno de 19%, destacando-se o crdito concedido em moeda nacional, que cresceu 32%. Tendo registado um crescimento dos indicadores de negcio do sector bancrio, na magnitude j referida, importa contudo, notar que o sector manteve-se slido, ao registar um rcio de solvabilidade de 18,62%. O Comit de Estabilidade Financeira foi institudo e realizou a sua primeira sesso no ms de Abril. Trata-se de um frum interno que possibilita a anlise e discusso sobre os principais indicadores de negcio e de risco, sua evoluo recente e a prazo, visando garantir o normal funcionamento do processo de intermediao financeira. No domnio regulamentar, destacamos as normas sobre as regras e procedimentos a serem observadas na comercializao de servios e produtos financeiros e sobre a preveno e represso do branqueamento de capitais e financiamento do terrorismo. A adeso s melhores prticas, padres internacionais e recomendaes do Grupo de Aco Financeira Internacional valeu um reconhecimento importante para Angola e para o seu sistema financeiro. Com efeito, tornamo-nos membros efectivos da organizao regional de combate ao branqueamento de capitais e financiamento do terrorismo e, no menos importante, foi publicado o primeiro Relatrio de Avaliao Mtua de Angola sobre esta matria. Adicionalmente, est em curso a preparao de normativos relacionados com a consolidao prudencial, governana corporativa, sistema de controlo interno e adequao dos normativos sobre solvabilidade, provises para crdito de cobrana duvidosa, grandes riscos e ainda sobre limites de concentrao. Ao longo deste ano, continumos a reestruturar o BNA no sentido de, termos uma organizao melhor preparada e adequada s exigncias do mercado. O Departamento de Superviso Prudencial das Instituies Financeiras (DSI) adoptou uma nova estrutura orgnica, destacando-se a juno das actividades de inspeco directa (on site) e indirecta (off site) e a criao de uma nova unidade responsvel pela anlise de risco sistmico e de sensibilidades (stress teste). O Banco Nacional de Angola entende que a educao financeira  um factor determinante para o aprofundamento e estabilidade do sistema financeiro e da sua maior participao no processo de desenvolvimento econmico nacional. A taxa de bancarizao situa-se em 23%, quando h pouco mais de 18 meses se fixava em 11%. O crescimento do acesso das nossas populaes aos servios bancrios s foi possvel com o comprometimento dos operadores do sector, pelo que agradecemos o sentido de parceria demonstrado. Estes resultados devem animar-nos e servir de motivao para darmos continuidade a este processo com o mesmo vigor, tirando tambm vantagem da regulamentao j publicada sobre correspondente bancrio. Uma das nossas mais importantes realizaes foi o lanamento do Portal do Consumidor de Produtos e Servios Financeiros. Trata-se de uma ferramenta que aborda conceitos bsicos associados s decises financeiras mais frequentes dos consumidores e servir de plataforma para o apoio e divulgao da informao financeira, bem como de canal privilegiado para o atendimento de reclamaes provenientes do pblico consumidor de produtos e servios financeiros. Ao nvel do sistema de pagamentos, o BNA tem continuado a exercer o seu papel de catalisador de novas solues, ao mesmo tempo que assegura a regulamentao necessria para promover o cumprimento dos objectivos de interesse pblico, designadamente a segurana e a transparncia. Em 2012 entrou em funcionamento o subsistema de transferncias a crdito, foi aprovado um novo modelo de cheque bancrio, e foi definido um modelo de referncia para o desenvolvimento do sistema de pagamentos mveis em Angola.  importante ainda realar o crescimento generalizado dos pagamentos electrnicos, em especial os que so efectuados na rede Multicaixa (com um aumento de cerca de 58%). Pese a notvel penetrao dos meios electrnicos de pagamento, reconhecemos que prevalece a preferncia pela utilizao da moeda manual, exigindo do BNA um cuidadoso acompanhamento da qualidade do papel-moeda em circulao.  assim que iremos introduzir a nova famlia de notas no decorrer do ano 2013, que traduziro uma melhoria das caractersticas fsicas e estticas das notas e das moedas metlicas, enfatizando os nossos valores culturais e aprimorando os elementos de segurana. Minhas Senhoras e meus Senhores; A Poltica Monetria em 2013 priorizar a desacelerao da taxa de inflao, cujo objectivo  de 9%, conforme estabelecido pelo Executivo Angolano na sua proposta de Oramento Geral de Estado submetido  Assembleia Nacional. Para tal, pretendemos aumentar a eficincia dos mecanismos de transmisso da poltica monetria. Trabalharemos para que, no mdio-prazo, seja a taxa de juro o instrumento principal da poltica monetria e a taxa de inflao a ncora nominal para efeitos de formao de expectativas por parte dos agentes econmicos. Por isso mesmo, daremos continuidade  implementao gradual do sistema de metas de inflao flexvel, consolidando o Novo Quadro Operacional para a Poltica Monetria. Estudos realizados pelo Banco Nacional de Angola mostram que a taxa de cmbio  uma das variveis que mais influenciam a inflao. Torna-se necessrio, portanto, continuar o processo de desdolarizao da economia. A partir de 1 de Julho de 2013, os pagamentos do sector petrolfero no mercado interno apenas podero ser feitos em moeda nacional, o que ser mais um passo importante nessa direco. Para terminar, e reiterando um aspecto que abordei na minha interveno em finais do ano 2011, gostaria de enfatizar a aposta que o sector tem que fazer no capital humano. Temos a responsabilidade de promover o conhecimento, o profissionalismo e a reteno de talentos na nossa indstria financeira. Quadros melhor capacitados e motivados so a garantia da continuidade e desenvolvimento do sector e do reforo do seu papel no fomento do crescimento econmico e social do pas. Aproveito a ocasio para expressar votos de boas festas e desejar a todos um ano novo pleno de realizaes pessoais e colectivas. Muito obrigado. Title: Interveno de Abertura do Governador Jos de Lima Massano na II edio do Frum Banca e Seguros da AJECO
text: Opening Speech by Governor Jose de Lima Massano at the 2nd edition of the AJECO Banking and Insurance Forum Your Excellency Mr. President of the Board of Directors of the Association of Economic Journalists of Angola, Distinguished Journalists, Dear guests, Ladies and gentlemen, It was with great satisfaction that we received the invitation from the Association of Economic Journalists of Angola, to deliver the opening speech of this Banking and Banking Forum The themes chosen for the sessions, linked to the growth and diversification of the economy, are in fact extremely important for our country and clearly financial has a fundamental role in achieving these objectives. The National Bank of Angola, as you know, is the regulator and supervisor of banking financial institutions, that is, commercial banks, and of some non-banking financial institutions that are also important in boosting the economy, such as credit unions, leasing and factoring companies. Considering the themes of the panels of this forum and the weight in the financial industry, I will focus my intervention on the banking sector. The first thought that comes to mind when we hear the reference to banks in the context of economic growth tends to be access to credit. But don't forget financial inclusion, which is an equally determining factor in economic growth, especially in our context where a large economy is in the informal sector. With regard to the granting of credit, an essential aspect to consider is the fact that banks work with foreign capital, mainly with their customers. Thus, the safety of these resources is their first priority and duty and a pillar in the sustainability of the banking sector. In addition, long-term economic growth depends on the efficient allocation of resources, that is, the granting of credit to viable companies and projects, the capacity of "production", both of goods and services, allowing them to invest and thus grow their activity. Granting credit to companies that are able to ensure the continuity of their activity does not contribute at all to economic growth. In economies dependent on bank credit, as is our case, banks play an important role in this efficient allocation of resources definition, they are always scarce. The better the efficiency in the allocation of bank credit, the greater its contribution to the development of the economy. On the subject of the granting of credit, I would like to highlight some important aspects, namely the price, which is made up of the risk premium and an interest rate of my guarantees. The risk premium depends on the assessment of credit risk. This assessment has to be rigorous and prudent, because as mentioned before, banks are interning the savings of their customers who have deposited them confident that they will be safe. Credit risk is dependent on the characteristics of the company, especially its viability, which gives entrepreneurs and managers the responsibility of not having the necessary skills in their companies to guarantee the bank the settlement of credit with some security. Here I would like to highlight the financial management of the company, including the preparation of reliable financial statements that reflect its activity. Without this "portrait" of the company, banks cannot; viability of the business or project. We must understand that the possibility of a company contracting credit depends a lot on the demonstration of the quality of its management, viability and financial capacity to fulfill the responsibilities it intends to assume before the bank. This condition has been one of the main reasons for the rejection of requests for EI banking. As a rule, and for the protection of value, market interest rates are subject to the level of inflation, but in this area we have had good news. It is already certain that we will end the year 2022 with an inflation rate below 16%, with the maintenance of the course of greater stability of the economy expected for 2023. The positive effects are beginning to be more visible. For example, the 12-month Luibor rate (the most used index for credit in national currency at the end of 2021 stood at 24.73%), is currently at 15.27%, a significant drop of 12.46 percentage points, relieving in many cases the burdens on companies and households with banking liabilities. But there are risks, both external and internal, that could influence this trajectory. The national economy remains very dependent on imports and oil exports. The latter, which are our main source of foreign currency resources, derive from the market price and the quantity exported, which is linked to the performance of the world's major economies. The monetary stimulus implemented during the Covid-19 pandemic and the war in Eastern Europe have been contributing to a generalized increase in PRC inevitably led to the rise in interest rates in the main international financial markets, reinforcing the probability of anemic economic performance. Finally, on this subject of price, I would like to mention the ratio of non-performing loans in the system, which is currently around 21%, having already reached higher levels. which result from the net interest margin, in turn dependent on the interest rates applied. i The As for guarantees, we recognise the important role they play for banks in granting credit and, consequently, the need to ensure that they are properly recorded and enforced. In this sense, the National Bank of Angola has been interacting with the competent authorities, seeking to bring importance and urgency to the facilitation of the registration of rights, including property, as well as for the ability to quickly resolve disputes involving a credit agreement. We are convinced that the simplification of administrative processes that has been promoted within the scope of the State reform will improve the business environment and contribute to more credit being granted. In the behavioural part of banks, the BNA issued regulations to ensure a more proactive, professional, responsible and faster action in dealing with credit applications, without neglecting the rigorous assessment of the associated risks. In any case, recognizing the importance of credit in the growth and diversification of the economy, in increasing the effectiveness of policy n transmission channels and in the protection of international reserves, the BNA formulated special credit regimes with lower nominal interest rates for certain sectors, regulated through Notice 10/2022 and those that preceded it, which establishes the special regime for the granting of credit to the real economy, and Notice 9/2022 which establishes special for housing credit to individuals and the construction of housing projects. These special regimes are based on the principle of using the mandatory reserves that banks have to keep with the BNA and which are not remunerated, as for the credit granted, allowing the subsidy of the interest rate, with benefit to all parties involved. The credit granted to the private business sector under Notice 10, until last October, totaled Kz 797 billion (about USD 1.6 billion amount, only 10 credits refer to restructured operations, totaling Kz 102.18 billion. The experience we have had with this regime recommends that it be maintained, and it may be possible to make adjustments so that the agri-food sector continues to stand out. The most recent credit initiative set out in Notice 9/2022, aimed at the housing segment, is taking its first steps. About 37.5% of the 168 submitted have already been approved and another 30% are, to date, under analysis by commercial banks. We must recognize that we still have few requests and but as the rules of access are better understood and mastered by both commercial banks and potential borrowers, the greater the dynamics of concession. We can hereby announce that in 2023, this Notice will be adjusted to consider self-construction for housing purposes. In conclusion, the success of our country depends on the sustainable growth of our economy and access to credit is one of the fundamental factors in development, but risk appetite must be established in order to ensure the sustainability of the financial system. Throughout this process, the transmission of reliable, relevant economic and financial information in a format that is easily understood by citizens is of importance. For this reason, the National Bank of Angola promoted two editions of Training Seminars Aimed at Journalists, with the purpose of conveying knowledge on topics within the scope of its activities. This Forum is another excellent initiative for the sharing of ideas and information of an economic and financial nature between the financial sector and ecoi journalists, so we congratulate the Association of Economic Journalists and wish for more similar achievements. It's already December, so I take this opportunity to wish you all happy holidays and a Prosperous New Year. I declare the Banking and Insurance Forum open. Thank you very much. No que diz respeito  concesso de crdito, um aspecto essencial a considerar  o facto de os bancos trabalharem com capitais alheios, principalmente com os dep seus clientes. Quanto melhor a eficincia na afectao do crdito bancrio maior ser a sua contribuio para o desenvolvimento da economia. No tema ainda da concesso de crdito, queria salientar alguns aspectos relevantes, nomeadamente o preo, composto pelo prmio de risco e uma taxa de juro de mi as garantias. O prmio de risco depende da avaliao do risco de crdito. Esta avaliao tem de ser rigorosa e prudente, porque como mencionado antes, os bancos esto a intern poupanas dos seus clientes que as depositaram confiantes que estaro seguras. O risco de crdito est dependente das caractersticas da empresa, principalmente a sua viabilidade, o que atribui aos empresrios e gestores a responsabilidade de t as competncias necessrias nas suas empresas para garantir ao banco a liquidao do crdito com alguma segurana. Devemos compreender que a possibilidade de uma empresa contratar crdito depende em muito da demostrao da qualidade da sua gesto, viabilidade e ca financeira para cumprir as responsabilidades que pretende assumir perante o banco. Por regra, e para a proteco de valor, as taxas de juro de mercado esto sujeitas ao nvel de inflao, mas neste domnio temos tido boas notcias.  j certeza que terminaremos o ano de 2022 com uma taxa de inflao abaixo de 16%, prevendo-se para 2023 a manuteno do curso de maior estabilidade de p economia. Os efeitos positivos comeam a ser mais visveis. Por exemplo, a taxa Luibor a 12 meses (a indexante mais utilizada para o crdito em moeda nacional final de 2021 situava-se em 24,73%, est actualmente em 15,27%, uma queda expressiva de 12,46 pontos percentuais, aliviando em muitos casos os encargos finam empresas e famlias com responsabilidades na banca. Mas existem riscos, quer externos como internos, que podero influenciar essa trajectria. A economia nacional continua muito dependente de importaes e das rec exportaes petrolferas. Estas ltimas, que so a nossa principal fonte de recursos em moeda estrangeira, derivam do preo de mercado e da quantidade exportada, de mercado est ligado ao desempenho das principais economias mundiais. A Quanto s garantias, reconhecemos o papel importante que estas tm para os bancos na concesso do crdito e, consequentemente, a necessidade de se assegurar que ser adequadamente registadas e executadas. Nesse sentido o Banco Nacional de Angola tem vindo a interagir com as autoridades competentes, procurando trai importncia e urgncia na facilitao dos registos de direitos, incluindo de propriedade, tal como para a capacidade de rpida resoluo de contendas envolvendo j um contrato de crdito. Temos a convico que a simplificao de processos administrativos que vem sendo promovido no mbito da reforma do Estado ir ben ambiente de negcios e concorrer para que mais crdito seja concedido. Na parte comportamental dos bancos, o BNA emitiu regulamentao para assegurar uma actuao mais proactiva, profissional, responsvel e clere no tratam pedidos de crdito, sem descurar a avaliao rigorosa dos riscos associados. Em todo caso, reconhecendo a importncia do crdito no crescimento e diversificao da economia, no aumento da eficcia dos canais de transmisso da poltica n e na proteco das reservas internacionais, o BNA formulou regimes especiais de crdito com taxas de juro nominais mais baixas a determinados sectores, regular atravs do Aviso 10/2022 e os que o antecederam, que estabelece o regime especial para a concesso de crdito  economia real, e o Aviso 9/2022 que estabelece < especial para o crdito  habitao a particulares e  construo de projectos de habitao. Estes regimes especiais assentam no princpio de utilizao das reservas obrigatrias que os bancos tm de manter junto do BNA e que no so remuneradas, como para o crdito concedido, permitindo a subveno da taxa de juro, com benefcio para todas as partes envolvidas. A experincia que temos tido com este regime recomenda-i manuteno, podendo merecer acertos para que se continue a destacar o sector agroalimentar. A mais recente iniciativa de crdito vertida no Aviso 9/2022, destinada ao segmento de habitao, est a marcar os seus primeiros passos. Cerca de 37,5% dos 168 apresentados foram j aprovados e outros 30% encontram-se,  data, em anlise pelos bancos comerciais. Devemos reconhecer que temos ainda poucos pedidos e mas  medida que as regras de acesso vo sendo melhor compreendidas e dominadas quer pelos bancos comerciais, quer pelos potenciais tomadores de crdito, maior dinmica de concesso. Podemos aqui anunciar que em 2023, este Aviso ser ajustado para considerar a autoconstruo para fins habitacionais. Concluindo e resumindo, o sucesso do nosso pas depende do crescimento sustentvel da nossa economia e o acesso ao crdito  um dos factores fundamentais p desenvolvimento, mas o apetite de risco deve ser estabelecido de forma a garantir a sustentabilidade do sistema financeiro. Em todo este processo, a transmisso de informao econmica e financeira confivel, relevante e num formato facilmente entendido pelos cidados  de importncia. Por essa razo, o Banco Nacional de Angola promoveu duas edies de Seminrios de Capacitao Dirigido a Jornalistas, com o propsito de transn conhceimento sobre temas no mbito da sua actuao. Este Frum  mais uma excelente iniciativa de partilha de ideias e de informao de natureza econmico financeira entre o sector financeiro e os jornalistas ecoi pelo que parabenizamos a Associao de Jornalistas Econmicos e auguramos mais realizaes semelhantes.  j Dezembro, pelo que aproveito para  todos desejar festas felizes e Ano Novo Prspero. Title: Intervention of the Deputy Governor, Pedro Castro e Silva, at the Official Launch of the Regulatory Sandbox
text: Intervention of the Deputy Governor, Pedro Castn e Silva, at the Official Launch of the Regulatory Sandbox Dear Guests Ladies and Gentlemen, Attuned to international trends and with the purpose of boosting financial inclusion through innovation, on 1st of August 2019, the National Bank of Angola in partn with the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Technology and Innovation and Acelera Angola, launched an initiative called the Innovation Lab of the Payment Sy: Angola - the LI SPA. LISPA's goal, from the beginning, has been to be a platform that encompasses 2 components, namely: 1 incubator for start-ups and 1 innovation hub. We saw in LISI way to contribute to the development of ideas promoted by young Angolans and others that, duly tested and consolidated, could contribute to their integration into th Angolan economy in general and the financial system in particular. Since the first batch of 10 startups incubated in the last quarter of 2019, we have come a long and joyful way. We received over 600 applications for our programmes impacted over 193 startups and welcomed 1 090 people in the various initiatives, from entrepreneurs, mentors and partners. We organised events with the local inno\ community, including in our universities. It is in universities that we found young people with brilliant ideas and the need to consolidate and transform them into bus For example, in 2021, through a 3-month programme we called LISPA Beta Start, we supported university students with businesses at the ideation stage. We received 49 applications, selected 15 and provided 135 hours of mentoring. We also organised another intensive 3-day programme called LISPA Beta Shift, wher participants learn business model validation, prototyping, testing and pitching. We received 355 applications, selected 24 and provided 32 hours of mentoring. Last y supported 118 startups through the same programmes. The successful evolution of LISPA allowed us to dream about the emergence of an innovation ecosystem in our country. That is why we have increased the range of partners to include banks, telecommunications companies, entrepreneurs, incubators belonging to other institutions and more recently, multilateral institutions. With range of partners, we are able to not only test business models but also financing models for startups. After these initial 4 years, we have reached a point where we have mature business models that are intended to become companies operating in the Angolan financial We are aware that in addition to supporting innovation and the emergence of new business models, we need to ensure financial stability and consumer protection for financial services. We therefore need to have an environment in which business models can be tested without harming the market. That is why the National Bank of Angola is today launching the Regulatory Sandbox, a project that aims to create a controlled environment where FinTech and Insui companies can test their products, services and business models, safeguarding the interests of consumers, security, as well as the integrity of the Financial System. The initiative we are launching, results from the need to provide a platform to encourage innovation in financial services, stimulate security, convenience, reduce commissions and other charges in access and use by consumers, promote competition, efficiency and fundamentally provide financial inclusion. The implementation of the Regulatory Sandbox has advantages for the BNA itself, as it will allow us to adjust regulation through learning by duly adapting regulatoi requirements or procedures that unintentionally inhibit innovation or make products, services or business models not capable of working successfully. Accordingly, \ to be able to perform our functions in a balanced and proportionate manner, establishing a favourable regulatory environment. The National Bank of Angola believes that this is a project that will bring added value to the Angolan Financial System, as new players, entrepreneurs and market participants in general will be able to contribute actively to the development of innovative solutions, making it easier for people and companies to access financial institutions, use the services and products offered, thus improving the quality and variety of the services on offer. I conclude by declaring, on behalf of the Board of Directors of the National Bank of Angola, the Launch Event of the Regulatory Sandbox. Thank you very much. Publicado Em: 13 de jan. de 2023

Title: Administrator Beatriz dos Santos' Opening Speech at the 3rd Edition of the Financial Education Workshop
text: Administrator Beatriz dos Santos' Opening Speed at the 3rd Edition of the Financial Education Workshop Your Excellency Mrs Luisa Grilo, Minister of Education Your Excellency Palmira Barbosa, Minister of Youth and Sports, Your Excellency Manuel Tiago Dias, Vice-Governor of the BNA, Members of the Board of Directors of the BNA, Distinguished representatives of the Executive, Esteemed Managers of the Financial Institutions Esteemed Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, On behalf of the Board of Directors of the National Bank of Angola I am pleased with your presence at this Financial Education Workshop, held on the occasion Savings Day, which begins today at the Magna Plaza of the currency museum and will last until 5 November, the date on which the 46th anniversary of the National Angola is celebrated. The idea of creating a special date to promote the notion of saving within societies emerged in October 1924, during the first International Economics Congress i This date was created with the aim of alerting consumers to the need to discipline their spending, allowing them to accumulate some liquidity in order to avoid situ over-indebtedness. The Financial Education Workshop is a BNA initiative, with the purpose of promoting Financial Education among children, youths and adults, through knowledge discussions on various topics, such as management of personal and family finances, savings and respective methods among others. This event also includes rec activities, entertainment and games based on financial topics, moments of clarification and distribution of information leaflets. The motto chosen for this Workshop is "Building financial independence and resilience", the same, aims to alert the target audience about the importance of s achieve financial independence, so let's not miss this opportunity to absorb the best for our education, because this is the time. In this way, the BNA reiterates its commitment to continue with the development of strategies that aim to promote management and savings habits among citizens them at the level of technological transformations in the financial sector, simplifying and streamlining processes to transform the daily lives not only of its professi( also of consumers, with emphasis on banking, insurance and the stock exchange, where today, payments already happen with a simple touch on our mobile phones. Ladies and gentlemen, We were all challenged by the Covid-19 Pandemic crisis, the consequent rise in the prices of essential goods and services, bringing to the fore the issue of n personal and family finances within families and proving its importance in ensuring peace of mind and resilience. Therefore, during the week of the Financial Education Workshop, we will delight our guests with an awareness campaign that aims to inspire children, young pe adults to learn how to handle money with savings as their primary goal, through the transmission of methods of financial management and entrepreneurship. Distinguished guests The event we celebrate today serves to recall the relevance of saving in the lives of families as a warning sign of the need for discipline in the decision-making pro this reason, the BNA within the scope of the protocols signed with the MED, MINJUD, MASFAMU, AEL and PNUD, reiterates the importance of developing educi financial inclusion policies appropriate to the needs of their respective target audiences, conferring improvements in the well-being of families by linking consumer to farmers integrating them in the markets with impact on economic activity, in chain. With this in mind, we created the Financial Education Booklet, aimed at children and adolescents in Primary and Secondary Education, in particular, and at the public. The first of a chain of annual booklets will be launched during this great event. This first booklet briefly describes the historical evolution of currency in tl and in Angola, highlighting the different stages of the history of our currency, as well as its main monetary units, used from the earliest periods to the present day, ra historical and cultural value of our currency as a symbol of national sovereignty. To conclude, I reiterate on behalf of the Board of Directors of the National Bank of Angola, our sincere thanks to those present and in particular to the Ministry of E represented by the Minister. To all our gratitude I hereby declare open the Financial Education Workshop, in allusion to World Savings Day 2022. Publicado Em: 31 de out. de 2022

Title: Interveno de Boas-vindas do Senhor Governador Jos de Lima Massano, no Frum sobre a Liderana Feminina no Sector Financeiro
text: Welcome Speech by Governor Jose de Lima Massano, at the Forum on Women's Leadership in the Financial Sector His Excellency Mrs. First Lady of the Republic of Angola, Dr. Ana Dias Lourenco; Your Excellency, Mrs. Deputy, Dr. Rute Mendes; His Excellency Mr. Vice Governor of the Province of Luanda, Dr. Gilson Carmelino; Excellencies, distinguished guests; Dear colleagues; Ladies and Gentlemen, It is with unrestrained satisfaction that we welcome you to this auditorium, to share experiences and strengthen the paths of gender balance in our society. Angola, a good example of affirmation of women, who since the beginning of its constitution as a nation have always been at the forefront for an independent, prosperous, socially inclusive country. Women's sacrifice, resilience and collective achievement for the common good is a source of permanent inspiration for everyone, but particularly for those who can influence behaviors that lead to the creation of social value. Therefore, we are honored by your illustrious presence at this event, which is also a simple tribute dedicated to Angolan women and, in particular, to laid stones in the foundations to make the national financial system happen. Welcome to the Currency Museum of the National Bank of Angola. Therefore, I invite Your Excellency, Your Excellency the First Lady of the Republic of Angola, Dr. Ana Dias Lourenco, to deliver the opening speech of this Forum on Women's Leadership in the Financial Sector. Thank you very much. Published in: Mar 22, 2023
